# Repository investigation report — template

Status: unfilled template. Do not present placeholders as completed findings.

## Agreed question and scope

Record the repository/source revision, permitted files/subsystem, client question,
reviewer, processing location and permitted external model use. State what is outside
scope and the agreed acceptance criteria. Omit credentials and private access URLs.

## Findings

| Agreed question | Answer | Exact source evidence | Verification | Unknowns |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Question 1 | Pending | File/line or symbol, revision/hash | Pending independent source check | Pending |
| Question 2 | Pending | File/line or symbol, revision/hash | Pending independent source check | Pending |
| Question 3 | Pending | File/line or symbol, revision/hash | Pending independent source check | Pending |

Separate observed declarations, verified runtime behavior and hypotheses. A static
caller relationship is not proof that every runtime caller was found. Label stale
or historical evidence and missing originals. Report tool/native fallback failures.

## Relationship and change-impact map

Include only relationships needed to explain the agreed change. Cite the source
for each important edge and distinguish declared imports, resolved bindings,
syntactic calls and independently verified behavior. Avoid unsupported complete-flow
or architectural certainty claims.

## Proposed change and verification

Explain the smallest proposed change, affected areas, acceptance tests and unresolved
risks. A plan is not an implemented or tested patch. If tests were actually run,
record source identity, commands, result and limits; otherwise mark them proposed.

## Effort and outcome receipt

| Measure | Value / evidence |
| --- | --- |
| Setup and indexing time | Pending |
| Investigation time | Pending |
| Source grading and review time | Pending |
| Report/walkthrough and rework time | Pending |
| Native fallback count and reasons | Pending |
| Provider/model identity and actual usage | Pending; distinguish measured from unavailable |
| Direct delivery costs | Pending; never substitute token counts for currency |
| Client-accepted findings | Pending explicit client review |

Assess whether the agreed questions are answered, the evidence is independently
checkable and the next action is clear. Record corrections and the final source
revision. No lower latency, token savings or better outcomes claim is established
by filling this report without a controlled paired comparison.

## Retention and next action

Record the agreed disposition of supplied code, originals, derived evidence and
backups. State the next action, responsible person and any separate scope required.
No contact, invoice, repository sharing or production action is implied by this report.
